note: Trained for 12 epochs on 6,036 SKU-110K and CC0 images (run fcos-r50-fpn-v3, best checkpoint from epoch 8). ImageNet mean/std are baked into the graph and anchor centres use the g * stride convention, so the browser preprocessing must not normalise again or shift centres. Dynamic INT8 does not run correctly on WebGPU in onnxruntime-web 1.31.1, so a quantised file sets webgpu_capable=false and the loader goes straight to WASM.
precision: int8 (dynamic quantisation of the FP32 export)
test_split: CC0 Supermarket Shelves test, 9 images, 1950 items, scored once
